To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
aridity indices increased significantly at the annual and winter scales, which is related to the decreasing trends in precipitation and the increasing trends in temperature at these two time scales.
the increasing trends of aridity indices are significant and are not influenced by short- and/or long-term memory.
the trends in aridity are increasing in the annual and wheat seasons, but are decreasing in the maize season.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of short-term and long-term memory, which has not been considered in previous studies.
the assessment of short- and longer-term memory effects on trends in aridity over Iran.
the effect of short-term and long-term memory, as well as the effect of seasonality, on the trend analysis of climatic data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of short-term and long-term memory is negligible in precipitation series, but it is important for temperature series.
short- and long term memory has not been detected for the precipitation and temperature series in Iran, and the trends in the aridity indices have been detected by the original Mann-Kendall test.
the trend in aridity in Iran is increasing at the annual and crop-growing seasons, except in the maize-growing seasons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
arid regions are more vulnerable to changes in precipitation and mean temperature than semi-arid regions and that arid and semi- regions will become drier in the coming years.

the effect of short-term memory should be taken into account when analyzing the trend in precipitation series and the effect of long-term memory should also be considered when analyzing the trend of temperature, ϕIDMs, and ϕBs.
aridity indices and temperature series are affected by the presence of short- and/or long-term memory, while precipitation series are not affected.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the trend of the aridity indices should be analyzed by taking into account short- and long-memory effects.
the trend of aridity is significantly affected by short- or long-term memory.
short- and long- term memory should be considered in trend analysis of precipitation and aridity indices, especially for temperature series.
